stops.note: earth, the root behind an earthenware cooking dish
settled in French for an earthenware dish, and the layered pate cooked in it
stops.meaning: an earthenware dish, or a layered pate
a dish of layered meat, fish, or vegetables set in a mold

current_meaning: a dish of coarsely chopped meat, fish, or vegetables, cooked and served in a mold
